nodes.label: Prior-Offset Double-Count Bug
nodes.rationale: refine_offset_20hz() returned prior_offset+residual, but process_sync_data() added prior_offset again, giving stored_total = 2*prior_offset + residual instead of the correct single-counted total. Caught via an accounting trace showing stored_total=-2.02s vs correlation-optimal best_grid_shift=-0.56 to -0.9s (chunks 220-280).

nodes.label: Offset Composition Fix (single-residual rule)
nodes.rationale: Each pipeline stage now returns a residual only; prior_offset is added exactly once at the start: s1.final_offset = prior_offset + residual_1hz; stored_total = s1.final_offset + residual_20hz. Also falls back to r.final_offset instead of the sentinel when 20Hz refinement fails. Breaking change: offsets change, downstream products need recomputation.

nodes.label: Production Workflow (chunk-by-chunk, periodic buffer)
nodes.rationale: Processes chunk-by-chunk over the stare record, loading lidar files on demand into a periodic buffer and restricting production to chunks with overlapping VectorNav coverage, to keep memory bounded while covering the full record.

nodes.label: Prior Reset Strategy (carry_forward / reset_each_file / reset_on_bad_quality)
nodes.rationale: Proposes a prior_reset_mode option to stop cascading sync failures where a bad offset poisons subsequent chunks: default :carry_forward (current/backward-compatible), :reset_each_file at file boundaries, :reset_on_bad_quality when accepted_sync==false. Isolated to the sync module; gradual opt-in migration.

nodes.label: Sync Failure Modes & Prior Handling
nodes.rationale: Enumerates causes of sync failure (wrong lidar_offset drift, chunks 430:432 test showing prior lidar_offset doesn't work, refinement doing more harm than good, missing lidar data from low-signal returns) and warns of a silent iterative failure mode: a bad offset poisons the next prior with no self-correction, cascading to all subsequent chunks. Proposes that on failure the prior should relax toward lidar_offset rather than reset, with a more robust refinement algorithm.
